metadata.primary_metric: validation_runner._weekly_points (exact DP lineup, +-10% realized-stat noise, synthetic week); known scoring components only on the real catalog
metadata.sensitivity_metric: imputed_truth_points: same drafted rosters scored with PF/DD/TD imputed into the realized stats (real catalog only)
metadata.bootstrap: 4000 percentile resamples of per-seed cluster means

decision.rule: promote only if the paired 95% bootstrap lower bound (by seed cluster) > 0 and no seat mean loss exceeds 5% on BOTH catalogs (nominal opponents), with at least 100 seed clusters and no budget fallback
